speaker: Doctor

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Avulsion Fracture of the Distal Phalanx)

Based on the inability to actively flex the distal interphalangeal joint and the mechanism of injury where the finger was forcibly extended, this is consistent with a rupture of the extensor tendon or an avulsion fracture. The X-ray should confirm if there is a bony fragment or subluxation at the DIP joint.

REQUEST TEST: Right hand X-ray (already requested, please review results).
REQUEST IMAGES: Right hand X-ray.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
